entities.name: Adun Oakenshield
entities.description: A famous warrior whose coming on Dominaria is foreseen in the Anvilonian Grimoire.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: Archdruid who fought a mage claiming to be Adun's son.

entities.name: Lily
entities.description: Described the claim of being Oakenshield's son as fraudulent.

events.summary: A mage on Aerona claimed to be Adun's son, fought Greensleeves and ended up hanging himself.
events.quote: Between 4074 and 4077 AR , a mage on Aerona claimed to be the son of Adun.
